title: Trap Map
purpose: Stocks where we think the market has it wrong, each with a dated event that will prove us right or wrong.
how_we_grade: Every call names a paper trade priced the day it was added. On the grade date, the call is Right if the trade is worth more than it cost at that day's close, and Wrong otherwise. Nothing else decides the grade. The "Why we hold this view" line explains our reasoning; sometimes it is better to be lucky than good.
disclaimer: Our opinion, not advice. Calls are tracked as paper trades only.

rules.price_source: Yahoo Finance option mids and daily closes
rules.grade_rule: Right if the paper trade's value at the grade-date close is above its debit; Wrong otherwise.

event.name: No end date
event.when: Held until a stop is hit
event.date_source: No end date: held until the fixed stop is hit

trade.text: $1,000 each in HIMS ($28.09), GDRX ($3.33), TEM ($77.97), GH ($183.10) and ABT ($102.20), bought Sep 18 at about 9:30 AM CT
trade.stop: Stop (JG's proposal, approved by Jared Oct 31): an equal-weight index of HIMS, GDRX, TEM, GH and ABT, set to 100 at the Sep 18 entries. Close the whole basket if the index closes below 90 (about $500 on the $5,000 cost). The stop is fixed and never moves.
trade.grade_rule: Graded only when stopped out: Right if we exit above cost, Wrong below.
trade.quoted: Prices: Oct 30 close (Yahoo Finance daily closes)

rows.what_proves_it: HIMS keeps adding subscribers (Q3 at or above 2.891M on Nov 9), TEM and GH keep growing revenue, and GDRX revenue finally moves above its $194–203M range.
rows.why_we_hold: Five companies making care cheaper and easier to get: online prescriptions (HIMS), drug price discounts (GDRX), AI-driven cancer testing (TEM, GH), and a big diagnostics maker (ABT).
